title: Arlington specific use permit
source_agency: City of Arlington Planning and Development Services Department

permits.name: Specific Use Permit
permits.agency: City of Arlington Planning and Development Services Department

explanations.trigger_explanation: If the base zoning district does not allow the use by right, Arlington may require a specific use permit approved through zoning review.

advisories: Supplemental site-plan, traffic, and tree-preservation materials may be requested with the application.
notes: Tier 2: official city zoning application materials verify the specific use permit pathway and associated submittal structure.
